scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with compelling headline, subheadline, and primary call-to-action buttons as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Load the application root URL (/) in the browser
steps.context: User arrives at the application as a new visitor

steps.description: Check that the hero section is visible above the fold with full-width layout
steps.context: Hero section should be the first thing users see

steps.description: Confirm a large, bold headline communicating core value is displayed (e.g., 'Shorten. Share. Analyze.')
steps.context: Headline must clearly convey the service's purpose

steps.description: Confirm supporting subheadline explaining the service is present
steps.context: Subheadline provides additional context to the headline

steps.description: Check that two prominent CTA buttons are displayed: 'Get Started Free' (primary) and 'Login' (secondary)
steps.context: CTA buttons must be clearly visible and distinguishable

test_cases.expected: Hero section renders with headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons visible above the fold
Component renders without errors and contains h1 headline element
BackgroundEffect component is used for gradient/animated background
Primary CTA uses FuturisticButton component with primary styling, secondary CTA has distinct secondary styling

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases 3-4 key product features with icons, titles, and descriptions as specified in REQ-2

steps.description: Scroll down from hero section to locate the features section
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero section

steps.description: Verify that 4 feature cards are displayed in a grid layout
steps.context: Features: Instant URL Shortening, Detailed Analytics, Easy Management, Secure Sharing

steps.description: Check each feature card has an icon, title, and brief description
steps.context: Each card should use GlassMorphismCard component style

steps.description: Confirm the features section is visually distinct from other sections
steps.context: Section should have clear boundaries and consistent spacing

test_cases.expected: Component renders 4 feature cards with icons, titles, and descriptions
Each feature card uses GlassMorphismCard component
Features include: 'Instant URL Shortening', 'Detailed Analytics', 'Easy Management', 'Secure Sharing'
Features display in grid layout that adapts to viewport size
